---
applyTo: "site/js/**,site/css/**,tests/**,scripts/**"
---

For application code, tests, and validators:
- preserve static deployment and browser-local state;
- keep language switching and bilingual contracts deterministic;
- do not weaken content or traceability checks to accommodate bad data;
- prefer pure/testable helpers for reusable logic;
- ensure UI changes remain usable on mobile and desktop;
- run the relevant unit/content audits plus build.
